[[File:Sense-plate.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sense plate.]]
A '''sense-plate''' was a component of a [[Pressure sensor|Pressure Sensor]]. Sense-plates cut to the size of [[security card]]s and wired to a [[data compiler]] could be used as a [[lectroticker]].
